scope: Driver targets at 120/130/132 mph club speed and published smash/spin limits for the gate
mason_own_numbers: NONE EXIST YET. 120+ mph is Mason's self-reported club speed (unverified). Nothing here measures Mason. No Instagram-derived or Mason-clip data used.

sources.note: TrackMan optimizer chart, club speeds 75-120 mph; vendor theoretical optimum, not player averages. Ends at 120 mph.

Reprint of the same TrackMan optimizer carry rows incl. 105 mph (154/11.2/3040/251 at AoA 0). The 75/90/120 rows agree with the fetched PDF. Its TOTAL column differs from the PDF (330 vs 321 at 120 mph) so totals are NOT taken from it.
Optimized driver table to 145 mph club speed (rows 124/131/138 used) and typical tables (1w 112 mph).
R&A report: TrackMan World Long Drive men's averages: 145 mph club, 214 ball, smash 1.48, launch 11.2, spin 2789, carry 352 yd; women 116/171/1.47/13.4/2813/282. Same report says PGA Tour smash 1.48.
One practice shot (T. Burke, 2016): club 141.3 mph, ball 211, smash 1.50, AoA ~+8, spin 1850 rpm, 409 yd. Single shot, extreme AoA; an existence proof, not a target.

Smash near 1.50 expected for driver, PW ~1.25; PGA TOUR driver 1.49, LPGA 1.49; Combine male amateurs: scratch or better 1.49, 5 HCP 1.45, 10 HCP 1.45, avg golfer 1.44, bogey 1.43; 'possible to have a smash factor that is too high with certain clubs'.
Physics: smash=(1+COR)/(1+m/M); 200 g head, 46 g ball, COR 0.83 -> 1.482 at 5 deg loft, ~1.465 at 10 deg loft; 1.500 needs ~229 g head.
Theoretical max smash 1.5 (200 g, COR 0.83, ~0 loft); pros mid/high 1.4x; hackers 1.25 or less.
Typical spin by club: 1w 2685, 3w 3801, 5w 4624, 7i 6585, PW 10399 (fast-swing table).
Ball overall distance test: 120 mph / 10 deg / 2520 rpm, 317 yd limit (+3 tol). Driver COR limit 0.83 per the rules (Tutelman refs).

driver.physics_note: (1+COR)/(1+m/M) with COR 0.83, 200 g head, 46 g ball = 1.482 at 5 deg loft, ~1.465 at 10 deg loft (Tutelman); 1.500 is an upper bound requiring ~229 g head; measured 1.50 shots exist (single shots, snippet-unverified)
driver.gate_recommendation: FAIL/flag any shot with smash > 1.50; WARN > 1.49; WARN < 1.30 for contact shots (poor strike)

hybrid.basis: published (fetched TrackMan PGA Tour PDF; ~1.46 hybrid)

smash.note: Max by club type is not published as a rule; the numbers are tour AVERAGES, and a gate ceiling for non-drivers should be set ~0.03-0.05 above the average (derived, not published).

driver.tour_average_sources: PGA Tour 2686 (113 mph, fetched); 2023 tour 2545 (repo value, snippet); Foresight typical 1w 2685
driver.gate_recommendation: driver at 120-132 mph: PASS 1800-3000 rpm, WARN 1500-1800 or 3000-3500, FAIL < 1200 or > 4000 (derived from windows above; not published thresholds)

launch_deg.note: Foresight 10-14 for all speeds; TrackMan point optimum falls with speed (9.3 at 120, extrapolated ~8 at 130)

caveats: TrackMan optimizer chart ends at 120 mph; the 130 and 132 mph point targets are LINEAR EXTRAPOLATIONS (basis=extrapolated) and give smash 1.49 at 130-132, at the physical ceiling: treat ball speed as upper bound.

Foresight rows are windows (launch 10-14, wide spin/carry ranges) with an implied smash of ~1.45; the two vendors differ by ~4-5% in ball speed at 130 mph (TrackMan-extrap 194 vs Foresight 189). Both are optimizer-type outputs, not measured player averages.
No sourced TOTAL point exists above 120 mph; only the Foresight window (published/interpolated).
No measured population average at 130/132 mph club speed was found. Nearest measured: World Long Drive men's 145 mph (snippet-unverified) and PGA Tour 113 mph.
Unverified = relies on search snippets (see sources[].unverified). Suggested gate bands and thresholds are derived here and are not published limits.
Model rows are env/ball_flight_analytic.py output at an ASSUMED dynamic loft; they show what the model gives, not what is real.
